author: spencer_tb
content: This one I think is an ethjs bug, the hash `0x7938...f20dab` is what you get when the slots are sorted numerically,  while `0xccc4...fa93`  looks like it comes from sorting them lexicographically. So I think there is a bug in the slot ordering on the ethjs side

author: holgerd77
content: Yes, we actually *had* a bug, but we have fixed and I have run an AI-simulated integration of your new test PR which got a confirmation. So seems we are on the same page and your new test vector also seems correct!
